title: Agent Replay: record, replay and regression-gate AI agent trajectories
summary: Python service and CLI that records agent runs (OpenTelemetry GenAI spans), stores them in PostgreSQL with content-addressed blobs, replays new agent versions against recorded tools behind a fail-closed side-effect sandbox, diffs trajectories to the first divergence, scores them in layers (checks, an invariants DSL, an optional LLM judge) and gates CI with bootstrap and Wilson intervals. Measured with fake providers: layered verdict precision 0.89 / recall 0.94 on 64 seeded-regression cases, first divergence localised in 23/23 changed cases, 70/70 cross-process replays identical.

title: Kafka LLM Enricher: exactly-once, budgeted LLM enrichment for Kafka streams on Spring Boot
summary: Spring Boot service and starter that consumes Kafka topics, enriches each record with a schema-validated LLM call and writes the result transactionally to an output topic. A PostgreSQL result ledger keyed by pipeline, prompt version, model and canonical input means rebalances, retries and replays never pay for the same call twice; it adds per-key ordered concurrency, provider rate limits with adaptive concurrency on 429s, per-tenant cost caps, skip rules, PII masking, retry and dead-letter topics, and Micrometer/OpenTelemetry cost and latency metrics. Measured in CI on 240 labelled synthetic disputes (fake provider) and 80 with qwen2.5:0.5b on Ollama: 0 prompts containing a card number, email or phone, 0 duplicate paid calls or deliveries, replays answered 100% from the ledger with 0 provider calls (360 records/s vs 46.5 on pass 1 with the fake); the exactly-once chaos test made exactly 40 provider calls and 40 committed envelopes for 40 inputs.
